correctness.rationale: For any unit x in c_0(I), choose k with |x_k|=1 and let s be the second-largest coordinate modulus. For every unit y, one of the two signs makes the k-th coordinate at most 1; all other coordinates for that sign are at most 1+s, while the opposite chord is at most 2. Coordinatewise monotonicity of every generalized mean gives the upper bound M_t(2,1+s), including t=0 and t=-infinity. A two-coordinate finitely supported y attains chord lengths exactly 2 and 1+s. The second-largest modulus is attained because c_0(I) vanishes at infinity. The range and equality cases then follow by realizing every s in [0,1].
risks: The verifier only stress-tests finite supports; the infinite-dimensional conclusion rests on the analytic coordinate proof, not enumeration.
The argument uses the real scalar field as stated.

originality.rationale: The defining 2023 article was inspected in full around the definition, examples, and its finite-dimensional extreme-point proposition. Text search found no c_0 treatment. The finite-dimensional proposition explicitly assumes finite dimension and occurs in the t>=1 section, whereas the accepted claim treats arbitrary infinite c_0(I) and every defining parameter down to -infinity. Targeted published-index searches for c_0, the second-largest coordinate, the explicit power-mean formula, and infinite-dimensional aliases returned no covering record. The closest indexed pointwise-James result is an ell_p constancy-threshold theorem; the closest c_0 result concerns the unrelated Delta constant.
residual_risks: Bibliographic and semantic searches cannot prove absolute novelty.

value.rationale: This is a natural complete classification, not an isolated numerical evaluation. It determines the entire pointwise James type profile on the canonical nonreflexive space c_0(I), for every parameter in the defining scale, from a single intrinsic coordinate statistic. It also identifies the full range and all minimizers and maximizers. The direct argument shows that the finite-dimensional compactness mechanism is unnecessary in c_0 and extends through the negative and geometric-mean regimes.
risks: The proof is elementary once the right second-coordinate statistic is identified; its value lies in the completeness and infinite-dimensional scope of the classification rather than technical depth.
